thread:
Harper Lee: i'm opening a small docs PR to harmonize the 'rate-limit' wording on the pricing page and to add a lightweight 'how to read your quota dashboard' section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/933 (internal)

Diego Morales: do we also change any API fields or just the copy and panels?

Harper Lee: only copy + saved dashboard captions and a couple SDK snippets. no API changes. adding a short migration note for partners.

Nina Gupta: can you include a tiny Ruby SDK example? a partner asked for it yesterday. also add a 1-line curl snippet next to the JS one.

Harper Lee: added both. Ruby example in PR (minimal):

```
# ruby net/http example
require 'net/http'
require 'json'

uri = URI('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/report')
req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
req['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{ENV['RW_KEY']}"
req['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
req.body = { tenant_id: 'acme', units: 300 }.to_json
res = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port, use_ssl: true) { |http| http.request(req) }
puts res.code
```

Harper Lee: curl quickcopy: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/report -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","units":300}'`

Diego Morales: for dashboards, what's the PromQL example you added? needs to be copy/paste safe for customers.

Harper Lee: sample PromQL in PR: `sum by (tenant) (increase(redwood_metered_tokens_total{source=~"(sdk|http)"}[30d]))` with a note explaining committed_units join for per-tenant ratios.

Nina Gupta: alert guidance? customers ask what good warning/critical thresholds are for usage vs committed.

Harper Lee: included recommended defaults: warning at 75% of committed, critical at 95%. also a short paragraph about burst-enabled accounts (recommend bumping warning to 85%). added a FAQ blurb explaining why burst doesn't change tier assignment.

Diego Morales: can you paste the minimal alert example you put in the docs? ops wants to reuse it.

Harper Lee: alert snippet (docs simplified):

```
ALERT HighQuotaUse
IF max_over_time((sum by (tenant)(increase(redwood_metered_tokens_total[1h]))/tenant_committed_units)*100[5m]) > 95
FOR 10m
LABELS {severity="critical"}
ANNOTATIONS {summary="{{ $labels.tenant }} close to committed quota"}
```

Nina Gupta: any change to dashboard permalinks? support needs those so they can find tenants quickly.

Harper Lee: only caption changes. i left the grafana UIDs untouched but added a new panel description that mentions the canonical permalink. also added an internal note to update saved links in the partner playbook.

Harper Lee: fixed the anchor and tightened table spacing. also added a short migration checklist for partner engineers: update SDK examples, check saved dashboard UIDs, notify customers 7 days before copy changes become visible.

Harper Lee: thanks  merging after one more approval. will post a short note in #announcements when live.
